row: This channel is an extension of the PEER (Partnership for Environment Education and Rural Health) Program at the Texas A&M College of Veterinary Medicine. The PEER website provides middle school and high school teachers with TEKS aligned lessons on a wide variety of subjects. PEER also has produced many educational videos featuring veterinarians, veterinary students, scientists, and more which can be found both on this channel and on our website at http://peer.tamu.edu/
